column1: # how the three factors of evidence/a8-factor.csv move when the runs that evidence/throttle-overlap.csv marks yes are dropped, on PHerc1447-seed26 only, written by tools/factor_sensitivity.py. A column with two runs has a median that is their mean. A column with one run has no spread and the run count says so. This file adds no claim: it says how far each factor travels when the disturbed rows are removed, and the reader compares that distance with the spread in c-stage-summary.csv.
